title: Distinguish Intent from Accident
description: When evaluating actions: - Ask: "Could this have been an accident or unintentional?" - Look for patterns: One mistake doesn’t indicate intent—watch for repeated behavior. - Check your biases: Avoid assuming intent without solid evidence. Example: If a coworker forgets to share notes, consider if it was an oversight rather than deliberate exclusion.
